style: Say with lively energy, like a friendly game show host
lines: Welcome to Robot Dance! Meet Bolt. Bolt does exactly what the cards say.
Tap a move to add a card. Then press Go, and dance along!
Welcome to the Fix-It Show! Dot knows the dance. Bolt reads the cards. Can you find the wrong card?
Press Watch Dot to see the dance. Then press Go.
Now press Go and see if Bolt can do it too.
Tap the wrong card. Then tap the right move.
Use the arrows to move a card.
Tap the trash can to take a card away.
Add the missing move. Then use the arrows to move it into place.
Tap the card in the wrong spot. Then use the arrows to move it.
Tap the extra card. Then tap the trash can.
Now tap the right move, or use the arrows or the trash can.
Add a card first. Tap a move!
That's eight cards! Press Go to see your dance.
All clear! Make a new dance.
Ta-da! Bolt danced every card, in order.
Round one: the Hello Dance! Watch Dot first.
Round two: Clap Clap Stomp! Watch Dot first.
Round three: Wiggle Time! Watch Dot first.
Round four: Robot Stomp! Watch Dot first.
Round five: Mixed Up! Two cards are in the wrong order.
Round six: Toes and Stomps! Two cards are in the wrong order.
Round seven: Something's Missing! Watch Dot carefully.
Round eight: One Too Many! Watch Dot carefully.
Team Star, it's your turn!
Team Moon, it's your turn!
Oops! Bolt tripped. Which card is wrong?
Look at Dot. What move should Bolt do here?
Uh oh! Bolt ran out of cards. Something is missing!
Whoa! Bolt has an extra step. Dot was all done!
Hooray! Bolt did the whole dance! You fixed the bug!
A wrong card is called a bug. Finding and fixing it is called debugging!
A star for Team Star!
A star for Team Moon!
Great job, everyone!
That's the show! Everybody take a bow!
Team Star and Team Moon, you're both dance champs!
